tooltip.dustandash.gear.hand_vacuum.summ: A hand-cranked tool for drawing residue from layers of Dust.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.hand_vacuum.deta: A rudimentary hand-cranked vacuum. When used on Dust, it may collect the layer and separate its contents.
A successful extraction wears the tool down; an empty cycle leaves only a brief pause.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.iron_vacuum.summ: A vacuum powered by Energized Dust for reliable extraction from Dust.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.iron_vacuum.deta: A vacuum driven by Energized Dust. At least one portion of fuel must remain in the inventory.
Each successful extraction wears the tool and may consume one portion of Energized Dust.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.sharpen_flint.su: A sharpened flint that trades the wielder's blood for Bloody Flint.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.sharpen_flint.de: A flint edge thinned by repeated working. Once it opens flesh, it leaves behind a piece of Bloody Flint.
While the prior wound has yet to settle, the edge will draw no more blood.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.standard_tool.su: A conventional mining tool with no additional properties.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.standard_tool.de: Made from ordinary materials. Its form alone determines its use.
A conventional melee weapon with no additional properties.
Made from ordinary materials. A fully recovered swing brings out its intended force.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.titanium_alloy_s: A titanium-alloy sword that empowers its wielder and slows whatever it strikes.
A straight sword forged from titanium alloy. Striking a creature briefly lightens the wielder's movement.
The same cut takes a measure of speed from its target.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.titanium_alloy_g: A titanium-alloy greatsword that steadies its wielder and weakens its target.
A greatsword forged from titanium alloy. Striking a creature briefly steadies the wielder's body.
The target that bears the heavy blow loses a measure of strength.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.gale_otaijutsu.s: A great katana shaped by a Wind Crystal, turning a fall into a heavier cut.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.gale_otaijutsu.d: A titanium-alloy sword reshaped by a Wind Crystal. A strike made while falling carries greater weight.
On impact, the gale quickens and steadies the wielder while slowing the target.
When used upon a block, the wind along the blade carries the wielder forward and upward.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.sunburn_mega_swo: A greatsword shaped by a Fire Crystal, answering each strike with flame and rupture.
A titanium-alloy greatsword reshaped by a Fire Crystal. Its strikes ignite the target and guard the wielder from flame.
Once its power recovers, the next strike causes a block-safe explosion around the wielder.
Blade and blast follow one another without waiting for the first wound to settle.
A long blade set with a Silver Crystal, releasing stored lightning through steel or flight.
A Silver Crystal set into a titanium-alloy sword. Repeated strikes gather lightning within the blade.
Normal charge may be loosed as a projectile; sneak-use compresses it into advanced charge.
Advanced charge may empower a melee strike or be fired as a stronger bolt.
The second wound left by lightning does not wait for the first to settle.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.lord_of_blood.su: A greatsword shaped by a Parasitism Crystal, reclaiming life through wounds and ritual.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.lord_of_blood.de: A titanium-alloy greatsword reshaped by a Parasitism Crystal. Charging it completes a Bloodboon Ritual around the wielder.
Every valid melee strike returns a small measure of life to the wielder.
Each ritual gathers another charge; greater charges bring greater harm and affliction.
At full charge, the next strike consumes the whole reserve and repays the wielder with recovery and resistance.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.rotten_blade.sum: A corrupted blade shaped by a Depravity Crystal, remembering wounds so they may be opened again.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.rotten_blade.det: A titanium-alloy sword joined with a Depravity Crystal. It remembers the creatures most recently cut by its edge.
Normal use tears those recorded wounds open from afar, but the corruption recoils upon the wielder.
Sneak-use releases corruption across a wide area, dealing damage, Wither and Slowness.
Corruption recognizes no master; the one who releases it is poisoned and slowed as well.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.judgement.summar: A necklace made with an Apotheosis Crystal, capable of rejecting one instance of damage.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.judgement.detail: A necklace bearing an Apotheosis Crystal. Worn at the neck, it wholly rejects one instance of damage dealt to its wearer.
After the rejection, the wearer is briefly invulnerable, and the necklace falls dormant from that moment.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.light_forged_hal: A back-worn halo made with a Light Crystal, calling down a Light Staff in brightness.
A halo made with a Light Crystal and suspended behind the wearer. It lends greater weight and speed to attacks.
When its wearer deals damage in sufficient light around either combatant, a Light Staff forms above the target.
The falling staff first pierces its target, spreads Light damage among nearby non-allies, then briefly remains at the impact point.
Excluded damage calls forth no staff; true Light damage does not wait for an earlier wound to settle.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.dark_forged_halo: A back-worn halo made with a Dark Crystal, returning a curse to attackers in darkness.
A halo made with a Dark Crystal and suspended behind the wearer. It strengthens life and armor while continually adapting the eyes to darkness.
When its wearer is harmed in darkness around either party, a thread of black smoke reveals the source.
The curse selects several distinct harmful effects from those assigned to it and lays them upon the source.
When a marked target is harmed again, part of that damage becomes life for the one who marked it.
If no living source can be cursed, the halo pursues nothing and instead returns part of the life that was lost.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.void_ring.summar: A ring made with a Void Crystal, removing its wearer from battle before death.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.void_ring.detail: A ring made with a Void Crystal. Before death, it restores the wearer's health, food and saturation.
Every status effect is removed, and the wearer is forced into Spectator mode for a time.
The ring remembers the former game mode and restores it on time, even across dimensions or a world exit.
When permitted by configuration, the Void Crystal also frees both halos from their brightness conditions.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.rain_crystal.sum: A crystal block consumed to bring rain to the current world.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.rain_crystal.det: A crystal block holding a change toward rain. Upon use, the current world immediately begins to rain.
The crystal is consumed and cannot bring another weather change for a brief time.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.sun_crystal.summ: A crystal block consumed to clear rain from the current world.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.sun_crystal.deta: A crystal block holding a change toward clear skies. Upon use, rain in the current world immediately ceases.
The crystal is consumed, and the weather timer begins anew.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.echo_activator.s: A small device that awakens a Sculk Shrieker's summoning property.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.echo_activator.d: A small device for exciting echoes. Used on a Sculk Shrieker, it grants the property needed to summon a Warden.
Used on Cake, it replaces the block with a Sculk Shrieker bearing the same property.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.nano_machine.sum: A nanomachine that rewrites an offhand item or turns its work upon the user.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.nano_machine.det: A nanomachine capable of rewriting an item's properties. In the main hand, it attempts to render a supported offhand item unbreakable.
When fully used from the offhand, the machine is consumed and turns its work upon the user instead.
Powerful Absorption and Regeneration appear first.
Resistance, Strength and enhancements to movement remain for far longer.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.position_selecto: A portable device that records a block position for an Item Sender.
A portable device for recording a block position. Used on a block, it stores that block's coordinates.
The stored coordinates and the block there remain visible, and may be read by an Item Sender.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.rock_solid.summa: A defensive device that trades movement for brief Absorption and Resistance.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.rock_solid.detai: A device that briefly hardens the body. Use grants Absorption and Resistance while inflicting Slowness.
Once activated, both Rock Solid and Indestructible enter their own dormant periods.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.indestructible.s: A defensive device that trades movement for greater Absorption and Resistance.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.indestructible.d: A device that drives the body toward an almost unbreakable state. Use grants stronger Absorption and Resistance while inflicting Slowness.
Once activated, both Indestructible and Rock Solid enter their own dormant periods.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.hand_vacuum.summ: A hand-cranked tool with a %1$s chance to draw residue from Dust.
tooltip.dustandash.gear.hand_vacuum.deta: A rudimentary hand-cranked vacuum. Used on Dust, it has a %1$s chance to collect the layer and separate its contents.

tooltip.dustandash.gear.iron_vacuum.summ: An Energized Dust vacuum with a %1$s chance to consume fuel after extraction.

book.dustandash.guide.name: Dust and Ash
book.dustandash.guide.landing: A record of gathering Dust, retaining Ash, and turning both into materials and machines.
dustandash.advancements.entry.title: Dust and Ash
dustandash.advancements.entry.descriptio: Dust settles and ash remains; every process begins by gathering what was left behind.
dustandash.advancements.sharpen_flint.de: Shape a sharpened flint, a small edge that trades blood for another material.
dustandash.advancements.mantle_mixture.d: Prepare a Mantle Mixture, providing the heated matter needed for Energized Cobblestone.
dustandash.advancements.dust_source.desc: Create a Dust Source; suspend it above suitable ground and wait for Dust to settle.
dustandash.advancements.bloody_flint.des: Obtain Bloody Flint, joining blood and stone into a single material.
dustandash.advancements.flint_pickaxe.de: Shape a Bloody Flint Pickaxe, the first mining tool of the process.
dustandash.advancements.hand_vacuum.desc: Create a Hand Vacuum, allowing residue within Dust to be collected.
dustandash.advancements.iron_vacuum.desc: Create a vacuum driven by Energized Dust, completing the collection of Basic Dusts.
dustandash.advancements.energized_cobble: Create Energized Cobblestone, sealing convertible energy within ordinary stone.
dustandash.advancements.integrated_block: Create an Integrated Block, allowing materials to be recombined by fixed position.
Create a Milling and Assembly Machine, joining grinding and assembly in one device.
dustandash.advancements.ash_collector.de: Create an Ash Collector, gathering the ash left by burning furnaces.
dustandash.advancements.integrated_frame: Create a Tier 1 Integrated Frame, granting the Integrated Block its first extension.
dustandash.advancements.reproduce_dust.d: Create Reproduce Dust, allowing plant matter to be formed again from Dust.
Refine an Ash Steel Ingot, binding ash and metal into a firmer alloy.
dustandash.advancements.centrifuge.title: Unified Field Theory
dustandash.advancements.centrifuge.descr: Create a Centrifuge, separating materials into Dust and other components.
dustandash.advancements.dark_energy_coll: Create a Dark Energy Collapser, preparing condensed dark-energy components for advanced machines.
dustandash.advancements.integrated_frame: Create a Tier 2 Integrated Frame, allowing the block to bear more complex combinations.
dustandash.advancements.ionizer.title: Electric & Exchange
